sentences.text: The bank’s note says a 2% pre-payment charge applies on foreclosure or pre-payment of the loan.

For loans and advances sanctioned or renewed on or after 1 January 2026, a UCB shall not levy pre-payment charges on floating rate loans granted for purposes other than business to individuals, and the applicable rule finding for that paragraph is not yet resolved for this case because the sanction date is needed.
The earlier RBI foreclosure-charge directions are no longer in force on 2026-11-23.
On the evidence provided, I cannot confirm a conflict with the RBI UCB rules because the sanction date is missing, and the only in-force rule found for the relevant paragraph depends on that date.

missing.searched: Checked the in-force UCB pre-payment-charge directions and the rule findings; applicability of the relevant paragraph still needs the sanction date.
